mechanism_narrative: A sustained month-over-month increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous month-over-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand that typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS (both down by at least 0.5% month-over-month) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods with FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and rising for 3 months, INDPRO declines fail to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year indicates rising inflation that typically prompts central bank tightening and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (relative to 2017=100), it indicates a contraction in manufacturing activity that typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous quarter-over-quarter decline in real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based economic contraction that typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in GDPC1 and HOUST (both down by at least 0.5% quarter-over-quarter) fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.5%), a decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.5%, PAYEMS declines fail to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases.
